errors.text: The fracture morphology is reversed: the target associates HPHT treatment with distributed or isolated microcracks rather than the elongated interfacial cracks of the brittle baseline, whereas the generated hypothesis predicts elongated cracks after treatment and treats isolated microcracks as falsifying evidence.

The cited evidence does not directly establish the claimed HPHT transformation in Al0.7CoCrFeNi: E1 concerns a different W-based refractory HEA, while E2 supports conventionally cast eutectic HEAs rather than the specified 6 GPa treatment.
